stepTitle: A. See Image. For which of the following residual plots is using linear regression a reasonable idea?

figureAlts.figure1.gif: Displayed below are three residual plots. For which of the following residual plots is using linear regression a reasonable idea, and why? What might the original graphs have looked like? Plot 1 shows a curved pattern with residuals ranging from -20 to 5. Plot 2 shows a random scatter of residuals around zero, ranging from -3 to 3. Plot 3 shows a fan-shaped pattern with residuals ranging from -10 to 15.
